global_issues.title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits Highest Since 2002
global_issues.note: The 10Y hit an intraday high of about 5.344% on Oct 1, the highest since 2002. Yields then retreated by late morning, and stocks closed slightly higher (S&P 500 +0.19% to 7,666, Nasdaq +0.04%, Dow +0.04%). The briefing's 'later partially reversed' matches this. One outlet (TheStreet) described the close as flat on rising yields, so the close is not fully consistent across sources.

global_issues.title: Oil Surges Over 4% on Middle East Risks and China Export Halt
global_issues.note: The China fuel export halt is confirmed: refiners suspended October exports outside Hong Kong and Macau, and PetroChina cancelled cargoes. Brent rose about 2.2% to roughly $100.15, crossing $100. I found no report of a 4%+ jump in Brent and WTI. I also could not find the 'third US aircraft carrier heading to the Middle East' claim in any source. Treat the >4% figure and the carrier claim as unsupported. The overall oil-higher direction is correct.

missing_major_news.title: Micron earnings blowout and guidance (FQ4)
missing_major_news.impact: MU: revenue guidance above consensus, long-term supply commitments up to $32B from $22B, and tight memory supply expected into FY27-28. This is a direct driver for MU, SMH and the AI-chip group (NVDA, TSM). The briefing does not mention it. Reports conflict on the early reaction (up after hours, down about 1% early), so confirm MU's move.

missing_major_news.title: Softer inflation data lowers odds of an October Fed hike
missing_major_news.impact: Rate-sensitive names (IWM, TLT, growth tech such as PLTR and CRWD) are affected. The 10Y still ended Q3 at multi-year highs, and the briefing's rate narrative omits the rate-hike-odds angle.

missing_major_news.title: Wider energy and geopolitical backdrop (US-Iran war disruptions, Saudi Yanbu loadings resuming, Ukraine strikes on Russian refineries)
missing_major_news.impact: This is the real context for oil, with supply worries partly easing from Saudi East-West pipeline restarts. It matters for Brent-sensitive moves and inflation expectations.

grok_report.summary: The yield-high story is accurate and the China export halt is real. The oil magnitude (+4% vs about +2.2%) and the aircraft-carrier claim are unsupported. The main omission is Micron's earnings blowout, which drives MU and the AI-chip group. The mood call is reasonable, but the CEG/VST framing and a few watchlist figures (TSLA %, MU) need correction.
